scope: All 686 copied original files were byte-scanned for exact credential values of at least 12 bytes from excluded sensitive response fields. Values are not retained in this record.
All 31 retained public header files were parsed for sensitive header field names; none remain.
Exact public HTML, documents and historical local/Windows path claims remain source evidence; generic cookie/authorization words in scripts or source markup are not credentials.
This is a bounded known-response-credential scan, not a general guarantee against every possible privacy concern. Public HTML must be displayed passively.
